provenance.ballPolicy: Separate alley pass approaches Moxie and is caught overhead at frame4/tick10. It follows her turn and behind-head reverse dunk, releasing at frame10/tick21; no ball drawn.
provenance.cleanupNotes: Removed smooth purple backdrop with Moxie RGB contrast alpha cleanup (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42); raw source retained; isolated pose components when packing.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete Moxie poses in 5x3. Frame4/tick10 overhead lob catch, shoulder gather, back-facing turn, behind-head reverse finish and right-facing landing form a distinct sequence. Identity, adult anatomy and purple/silver uniform remain consistent. Ball/pass partner/hoop absent from art; separate ball track recorded and backdrop cleanup reviewed.

provenance.packaging: package-dunk15.py --isolate-components; 128x96 cells; baseline94; WebP88; no generated extra frames

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance

runtimeTrackCalibration.source: human source-cell estimate then native 120% capture; upper hand center is near x35,y16 in 128x96 frame9 cell; formulas x=(cellX-64)*0.8125/2.2, y=(89-cellY)*0.8125/28
runtimeTrackCalibration.notes: Aerial contact points in frames8-10 calibrated from the visible Moxie hand and checked at last carried tick20 in both facings at standard and120% native Canvas zoom. Frame10 ball resolves at the rim on tick21. Raw source ballTrack remains preserved separately.

reviewNotes: Full atlas reviewed on dark and light backgrounds after margin normalization: separated complete human poses, clean alpha, at least5px vertical and horizontal clearance, no crop bleed, Moxie canon and no baked ball.
